common: Unified project instruction files: nearly all read AGENTS.md (Claude Code uses CLAUDE.md and also supports it)
MCP is now standard (Pi a deliberate exception); plugins = skills+MCP+hooks bundled for distribution
Agent Skills (SKILL.md) became a cross-tool format, importable between Claude Code/Codex/Muse
Plan first, then execute: plan mode/spec approval + /goal for long-running task goals
Parallel subagents + git worktree isolation, multi-agent boards/command centers
Tiered permission approval + auto/yolo mode; OS-level sandboxing (Seatbelt/bubblewrap) now widespread
Lifecycle hooks (Pre/PostToolUse) for auditing and guardrails
Headless -p/exec + SDK for CI; automatic context compaction; local↔cloud session handoff

differences.summary: Own models: Claude Code, Codex, Grok Build, Muse Code; multi-vendor hosted: Cursor, Copilot, Kiro; any BYOK: OpenCode, Cline, Pi
Open source: Codex CLI, OpenCode, Kilo, Cline, Qwen Code, Pi, Warp (AGPL); closed: Claude Code, Cursor, Antigravity CLI
Terminal-first: Claude Code, Codex, Grok Build, Pi; IDE-first: Cursor, Kiro, Devin Desktop; orchestration console: OpenHands, Oz
Sandbox by default: Codex, Muse Code; optional/partial: Claude Code, Cursor, Antigravity, Grok Build; approvals only: Cline, Amp; no permission system: Pi
Semantic indexing: Cursor, Copilot, Kilo, Warp, Devin; agentic search+LSP: Claude Code, OpenCode; repo map: Aider
Spec-driven: Kiro; plan mode: most; vendor-picked models: Amp; minimal, nothing built in: Pi; dual-model plan+execute: Devin Fusion
Subscription quota: Claude/ChatGPT/SuperGrok/Kimi; credits: Copilot, Kiro, Warp; zero-markup pay-as-you-go: Amp, Kilo; free BYOK: OpenCode
ACP hosts that run external agents: Zed, Devin Desktop, OpenHands, Warp; Codex can also be called as an MCP server
imec: on GLM-5.3-Flash, Codex uses about half the output tokens of Claude Code/Pi at a similar success rate; Claude Code has the largest input context
On TB4, swapping the harness for the same model mostly stays within ±3 points; Grok 4.7 scores 8.8 higher in Grok Build, Qwen3.8 Max 11.9 lower in Claude Code

notes: Feature matrix from official docs/READMEs and third-party profiles (2026-10); null = unverified, not unsupported; partial = limited/needs a plugin/only some form factors.
In harness_scores, cross-harness differences for the same model are confounded by trial count, effort, timeouts, submission date and image differences; they are not pure harness effects.
TB4 official board (vendor harness) vs Vals (mini-swe-agent): Opus 5.5 64.8 vs 65.15, GPT-6 Astra 58.2 vs 59.6, most gaps ≤3 points; Grok 4.7 Grok Build +8.8, Qwen3.8 Max 0902 in Claude Code −11.9.

Vals' own runs of GPT-5.5 under the Codex and Factory harnesses score only 57.3% on TB2.1, versus 83.1% for Codex CLI on the official board and 76.4% for Vals' Terminus 2: native harness config/timeout handling strongly affects scores.

imec: the same open model's success rate under Claude Code/Codex/Pi differs by only 2–3 tasks; on GLM-5.3-Flash, Codex roughly halves output tokens and runtime, while Claude Code uses 1.35–2.5x Codex's input tokens; without blocking git history, scores inflate to 75–97% (the model gets the answers from git log).
Anthropic's launch table gives Opus 5.5 TB4 66.4% (xhigh) and Sonnet 5.5 70.6% without naming the harness; the official board records 64.8 / 61.8 with the Claude Code harness.
AA Coding Agent Index scores harness+model combinations; the Devin Fusion CLI row is a two-model combo and cannot be treated as a single-model score.

2026 status changes: Google replaced the open-source Gemini CLI with the closed Antigravity CLI (shut down for individual users on 2026-06-18); Windsurf renamed to Devin Desktop (2026-06-02) and Cascade retired on 2026-07-01; Roo Code shut down on 2026-05-15 (users moved to Kilo/Cline); Kimi CLI (Python) archived and replaced by Kimi Code CLI (TS); Amp spun off from Sourcegraph; Warp open-sourced under AGPL on 2026-04-28; opencode repo moved to anomalyco; Cursor acquired Continue.

New entrants: xAI Grok Build (2026-05-25 beta), Meta Muse Code (2026-08-05 beta), Cognition Devin Fusion (planner + executor dual model), Pi (minimal harness, the base of OpenClaw); the AA index also has 'DeepSeek Harness' and Reflection 'Mirror', not listed separately due to insufficient information.

Not listed separately: Goose (now in the Linux Foundation's AAIF), Junie CLI (JetBrains, LLM-agnostic, TB2.0 71%), Augment/Auggie (completions dropped for non-enterprise plans since 2026-03, Context Engine remains), Crush (FSL-1.1-MIT), Trae Agent, Jules (current status unverified).
Version reference (third-party): Claude Code v2.1.310, Codex CLI v0.164.0 (both 2026-10-23); Grok Build v1.0.70 (2026-10-23).
The latest entries in the official SWE-bench Verified board JSON stop at 2026-02, with no scaffold comparison for the current two model generations, so no data was taken.
Qwen Code README: 7 Qwen Code versions running the same Qwen 3.7 Max on SWE-bench Verified averaged 76.4–77.8%, so iterating the same harness shifts scores by about ±1 point.

Benchmark id notes: terminal-bench-4 / terminal-bench-2.1 / terminal-bench-2 use different task sets and are not directly comparable; swe-bench-pro-imec64* and swe-bench-pro-pilot10 are subsets, do not mix them with the full SWE-bench Pro; aa-coding-agent-index is in index units.
